title: A TENNIS LAB - PROMO

assets.source: npm three@0.186.0 (build/ and a subset of examples/jsm), unmodified

brief: 32-second pre-opening promo for A Tennis Lab (ATL), an indoor tennis training studio in Seattle. Facts allowed: 4 half-court training lanes plus a practice wall called The Wall; programmable ball machines; human coaching; rigorous, focused practice that turns into progress you can take into matches; every session picks up where the last one left off (下次接着练); atennislab.com; call to action: join the waitlist. Forbidden: any AI / machine learning / smart / algorithm language, pricing, address, hours, opening date, invented stats or testimonials. Direction: serious, premium training brand. One continuous three.js world in a dark studio: a lit half-court lane with a ball machine feeding balls into floor targets, a crane reveal of all four lanes and The Wall, reps accumulating as landing marks, last session's marks kept while this session continues, then the lane opens into a full match court and the last practice ball is played across the net. Closing card: wordmark, atennislab.com, Join the waitlist.
